inputInstructions: seedWithExistingMetadata feeds the file's, asset's and database's existing metadata and the file's attributes into the analysis prompt; the embedding always carries them, whatever this switch says. includeSiblingFiles downloads the files beside the input (textures, .mtl, .bin) so a multi-file model renders with its materials. renderViews is the number of views rendered for a 3D file (six orthographic first, then perspective). maxTextChars caps the text excerpt sent to the model for text, data and document files. writeAssetKeywords additionally merges the file's keywords and category into the asset-level genai_asset_keywords and genai_asset_categories metadata. embeddingIncludeTextExcerpt includes the file's text excerpt in the text that is embedded for natural-language search. writeExtractedMetadata promotes the file's extracted attributes to typed ext_* metadata. extractGeoLocation writes a GeoJSON location when the file carries a position and has no location yet. videoSegmentSeconds analyses a video in fixed time windows of that many seconds and publishes one search vector per window (0 is off; 2 or more is on, at most 360 windows per video; each window costs three model images). contentChunking also embeds the full text of document, text and data files in overlapping chunks so a topic anywhere in a long file is found. classificationVocabulary is the category, subcategory, style, material and color vocabulary the model chooses from; edit it with 'vamscli pipeline template update --config-body-file' (allowUnlisted false restricts the model to the listed values). A deploy restores the shipped default.

tagSchema.label: Seed the analysis prompt with existing metadata
tagSchema.description: Feed the file's, asset's and database's existing metadata and the file's attributes into the analysis prompt. The embedding always carries them, whatever this switch says.

tagSchema.label: Include sibling files
tagSchema.description: Download the files beside the input file (textures, .mtl, .bin) so a multi-file 3D model renders with its materials.

tagSchema.label: Render views
tagSchema.description: Number of views rendered for a 3D file and sent to the analysis model (at most eight are sent).

tagSchema.label: Maximum text characters
tagSchema.description: Cap on the text excerpt of a text, data or document file sent to the analysis model.

tagSchema.label: Write asset keywords
tagSchema.description: Also merge the file's keywords and category into the asset-level genai_asset_keywords and genai_asset_categories metadata.

tagSchema.label: Embed the text excerpt
tagSchema.description: Include the file's text excerpt in the text embedded for natural-language search.

tagSchema.label: Write extracted metadata
tagSchema.description: Promote the file's extracted attributes to typed ext_* metadata: dimensions, units, size category, counts, camera, codecs, resolution, page and word counts, and more, per file class.

tagSchema.label: Extract geo location
tagSchema.description: Write a GeoJSON location from EXIF GPS, an IFC site, geographic point-cloud bounds, a 3D Tiles region or a GeoJSON footprint when the file has no location metadata yet.

tagSchema.label: Video segment interval (seconds)
tagSchema.description: Analyse a video in fixed time windows of this many seconds and publish one search vector per window, so a scene is found even when it fills only part of a long recording. 0 turns the per-window analysis off; a value of 2 or more turns it on (at most 360 windows per video, so a long video is sampled coarser). Each window sends three frames to the analysis model: about USD 0.005 per window with Claude Haiku 4.5 and about USD 2 per hour of video at a 10-second interval, plus one embedding call per window, which is why the default is off.

tagSchema.label: Embed document content in chunks
tagSchema.description: Also embed the full text of document, text and data files in overlapping chunks of 1,600 characters, so a file is found by a topic that appears anywhere in it, not only in its first pages. At most 1,000 chunks per file version, about a thousand embedding calls for a long document, well under a cent with Titan Text Embeddings V2.
